Ruling-ref: seat ruling (repo:objectstack#3, 2026-11-17 16:36Z) on this card's ask, option A

Scope (seat ruling A): the flow label and the approval-step labels show the package's viewer-language translation where one exists, falling back to the authored label; the authored source label stays visible in the selection inspector beside the translation (Studio is the authoring surface). ⛔ No new spec keys: the spec has no keys for decision/other node labels or edge labels, so those stay authored text; if the filer wants them, the filer files that card. `Clause-②: yes` covers a possible new studio-namespace key for the source-label line (locale keys only; L1 at TIER_DEFAULT the review of record); the PR states whether one was added.

Lease `o3-D` (seat post #34584).
